meta.title: Improve Headers construction
meta.body_summary: Optimize Headers constructor when called without arguments by exposing and using toJSNewlyConstructed; includes C++ changes in JSFetchHeaders.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex C++ optimization; CI build failures across all platforms led to close without merge; no formal review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 15 added lines across 2 files, this is a tiny change by absolute volume. It is a small-step performance PR that was closed due to CI build failures, not merged.

review_details.concern_detail: robobun CI reported clang compilation errors on line 136 of JSFetchHeaders.cpp and build failures on multiple platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
review_details.performance_claim: Optimize Headers constructor when called without arguments; expose and use toJSNewlyConstructed.

core_change_summary.description: Added a specialization for the Headers constructor in JSFetchHeaders.cpp to use toJSNewlyConstructed when called without arguments, aiming to skip unnecessary initialization overhead.
change_trajectory: Single commit (373e20e) modified JSFetchHeaders.cpp and .h to add the optimized constructor path.
